title: Autoclave Biohazard Waste Protocol
author: Steven W Wilhelm
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.6cyhaxw
materials: Autoclave the processed waste on gravity cycle.

steps.title: Check waste container fill level
steps.instruction: If the waste container is more than three‑quarters full, it must be processed for autoclaving.

steps.title: Determine appropriate autoclave cycle
steps.instruction: Consult the autoclave for the correct cycle time based on the amount of trash being autoclaved (information is posted on the autoclave).

steps.title: Prepare bag waste for autoclaving
steps.instruction: Set up the bag containing trash for autoclaving following the steps below.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the bag into a wide autoclavable tray that has a polypropylene (PP) bottom; do NOT use a HDPE tray because it will melt.
Pour 100 mL of de‑ionized water into the bag.
Pour an additional 100 mL of de‑ionized water into the tray, between the container and the bag.
Close the bag loosely and apply a strip of autoclave tape to the bag.

steps.title: Prepare sharps container for autoclaving
steps.instruction: Set up the sharps container for autoclaving as described below.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the sharps container into a wide autoclavable tray with a PP bottom; avoid HDPE trays.
Pour 100 mL of water into the interior of the sharps container.
Close the lid until it snaps shut.
Apply autoclave tape to the lid.

steps.title: Cool and dispose autoclaved waste
steps.instruction: After the autoclave cycle completes and the waste has cooled, place the autoclaved waste into the designated trash bin located next to the autoclave.

substeps.instruction: For bag waste, transfer the cooled bag to the designated bin.
For sharps waste, transfer the cooled sharps container to the same designated bin.
